5.  Report On Posting
  I, Javier Barraza, Special Projects Coordinator, certify that a true and correct copy of the foregoing
  meeting agenda was properly posted on May 28, 2026, seventy-two hours prior to the scheduled
  meeting, as required by law.

6.  Meeting Compensation Disclosure
  Pursuant to Government Code Section 54952.3: Disclosure of compensation for meeting
  attendance by the Planning Commission is $125.00 per meeting.

7.  Consent Calendar
  Business items, except those formally noticed for public hearing or require discussion, are placed in

  1
   the Consent Calendar. Any Commissioner may request that any Consent Calendar item(s) be
  removed, discussed, and acted upon separately. Items remaining on the Consent Calendar will be
  approved in one motion unless another action is taken. The Chair will call on anyone wishing to
  address the Commission on any Consent Calendar item, which has not been pulled for discussion.

  A.  PLANNING COMMISSION MINUTES FOR MAY 5, 2026
  The Planning Commission will consider approval of the minutes for the Regular
  Planning Commission meeting of May 5, 2026.

  Documents:

  PC Minutes 05.05.26.pdf

8.  Public Hearings
  Public hearings are those items formally noticed under the requirements of South Gate Municipal
  Code Section 11.50.020. The Planning Commission shall hold a public hearing and make required
  findings to either approve, approve with conditions, or deny an application by adopting a resolution.

9.  Open Session Items
  Open session items are intended to be discussed by the Planning Commission but do not require a
  public hearing. These include presentations, trainings, and workshops.

  A.  REORGANIZATION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION
  The Planning Commission will consider nominating and selecting a new Chair and
  Vice-Chair.

  Documents:

  AB_PC_Reorganization_060226.pdf

  B.  WORKSHOP ON PERMIT TYPES AND PLANNING COMMISSION
  RESPONSIBILITIES
  Staff will give a presentation on permit types and Planning Commission
  responsibilities.

  It is recommended the Planning Commission receive the presentation, ask questions
  of staff, open the item for public comment, and RECEIVE and FILE the item.

  Documents:

  AB_PC_Workshop_Permits_and_Responsibilities_060226.pdf
  PowerPoint - Workshop_Permits_and_Responsibilities_060226.pdf

10. Comments
  At this time, members of the public and staff may address the City Planning Commission regarding
  any items within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Planning Commission. No action may be
  taken on items not listed on the agenda unless authorized by law.

  A. AUDIENCE COMMENTS

  B. CITY STAFF COMMENTS

  2
   C. PLANNING COMMISSION COMMENTS

11. Adjournment

  In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
  in the Planning Commission meeting, please contact Community Development Department.
  Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the City to make reasonable arrangements to
  assure accessibility.

  All of the above resolutions and zoning case items have been determined to be categorically
  exempt pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines unless otherwise
  stated.

  Any final action of the Planning Commission, on this agenda, is appealable to the City Council upon
  filling the request with the City Clerk prior to 5:00 p.m. on Thursday, June 18, 2026.

  Materials related to an item on this Agenda submitted to the Planning Commission after distribution
  of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the Community Development
  Department, 8650 California Ave., South Gate, CA 90280. For more information, call (323) 563-
  9565 or visit the City's website at www.cityofsouthgate.org.

  Commissioners discussed mural review procedures, community identity, maintenance

  A. CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT (CUP NO. 26-01) AND SITE PLAN AND DESIGN REVIEW (PL NO.
  26-0007) FOR A “GREEN OPERATION,” PARKING FOR A COMMERCIAL FLEET OF BOX
  TRUCKS, CONSTRUCTION OF A TWO-STORY OFFICE AND STORAGE BUILDING,
  CONSTRUCTION OF A PARKING CANOPY, AND OTHER IMPROVEMENTS FOR A PROPERTY
  LOCATED AT 10000 ATLANTIC AVENUE (APPLICANT: CATALDO)

  Planning Manager Signo gave a presentation. Staff recommended the Planning Commission:

  1. Find that in accordance with CEQA, this project qualifies for a categorical exemption
  under CEQA Guidelines Section 15332 (Class 32) “In-Fill Development Projects,” and is
  thereby exempt from CEQA in that urban uses surround the project site, and the project
  meets all other requirements to qualify for a Class 32 exemption.

  2. Adopt Resolution No. 2026-06 approving CUP No. 26-01 and PL No. 26-0007.

  Commissioners discussed traffic circulation, environmental impacts, EV truck operations,
  landscaping improvements, charging infrastructure, and the afternoon operating time.

   City of South Gate
  PLANNING COMMISSION

  For the Regular Meeting of: June 2, 2026
  Planning Manager: _________________
  John F. Signo, AICP

SUBJECT: REORGANIZATION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION

PURPOSE: To consider reorganizing the Planning Commission by nominating and selecting a
new Chair and Vice-Chair for a one-year term; the selection will be ratified by a majority of the
South Gate Planning Commission

DISCUSSION: Pursuant to South Gate Municipal Code Section 1.12.120, at the first Planning
Commission meeting held during the month of June, the Planning Commission shall elect a
chairperson from among its duly appointed membership.

RECOMMENDED ACTION: To nominate and select a new Chair and Vice-Chair for the
Planning Commission.

SUBJECT: WORKSHOP ON PERMIT TYPES AND PLANNING COMMISSION
RESPONSIBILITIES

PURPOSE: To review the City’s permit types and the responsibilities of the Planning
Commission.

DISCUSSION: Staff will provide a presentation on the permit types provided in the South Gate
Municipal Code Section 11.51.030, give an overview of permit activities in 2025, and discuss the
Planning Commission’s responsibilities under the Brown Act in conducting a public meeting.

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Receive and file.
